message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, all 3 tests.

The cause was the vendored `slugify`, which deletes any non-ASCII letter instead of converting it. I didn't touch it, because `vendor/slugify/index.js` is marked do-not-edit.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. `postSlug` now decomposes accents and removes the combining marks (`é` → `e`) before calling `slugify`.

Shop product URLs also use `slugify` directly, so they still drop accented letters. I left them alone since you only asked about blog posts. Do you want the same treatment there?
